# AVDOXA

> AVDOXA designs, integrates, services, and manages reliable audio, video, lighting, control, and broadcast systems. Houses of Worship are a core market alongside corporate, government, education, construction, performing arts, theater, and event-space partners.

Canonical site: https://avdoxa.com/
Location: Overland Park, Kansas
Phone: 913-383-0243
Email: info@avdoxa.com

## Core pages

- [Home](https://avdoxa.com/): Markets, services, managed support, credentials, and featured work.
- [About AVDOXA](https://avdoxa.com/about/): Company story, the meaning of AVDOXA, and the team.
- [Services](https://avdoxa.com/#managed): Consulting, design, integration, commissioning, training, managed services, and lifecycle support.
- [Service request](https://avdoxa.com/service/): The essential support path for operational issues and urgent help.
- [Portfolio](https://avdoxa.com/portfolio/): Case studies organized by House of Worship, Corporate Conference Room, and Event Space.
- [Camera packages](https://avdoxa.com/shop/): Four designed production packages with components and published pricing.
- [TDX](https://avdoxa.com/tdx/): Tech Director Experience event information and registration.
- [Careers](https://avdoxa.com/careers/): Employment information.
- [Brand and voice guide](https://avdoxa.com/brand-guide/): Approved visual palette, voice principles, and usage guidance.
